realm.name: STUDENT
realm.description: Estudiante — acceso a planeación curricular personal

realm.name: STAFF
realm.description: Personal administrativo — acceso a datos de programas asignados

realm.name: ADMIN
realm.description: Administrador de la plataforma — acceso total a /admin/**

users._comment: Seed ADMIN user. Change password on first login. Never use in production.

clients.name: Brújula Backend (Slice 1 — confidential OIDC)
clients.description: Confidential backend client for server-side OIDC login flow (authorization_code). Slice 1.

clients.name: Brújula Frontend (SPA — public client)
clients.description: Public OIDC client for the Brújula SPA. Slice 1 + Slice 2 (verify-email redirect URI added in Slice 2).

clients._comment: Slice 2 addition (S2-A): service-account client for app-driven student registration via Keycloak Admin API. Confidential + service accounts enabled. Secret via env BRUJULA_KEYCLOAK_REGISTRATION_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET — NEVER commit real secret.
clients.name: Brújula Registration Service Account (Slice 2)
clients.description: Confidential service-account client for backend-driven user provisioning (registration, email verification trigger, password reset trigger) via Keycloak Admin API. Requires manage-users + view-users roles on realm-management.

clientScopeMappings._slice2_comment: Slice 2 addition: grant realm-management roles to brujula-registration-svc service account. manage-users allows POST /admin/realms/{realm}/users. view-users allows GET /admin/realms/{realm}/users.

_comment: realm-export.json for brujula-dev. Slice-1: backend OIDC client + SPA public client + ADMIN seed user. Slice-2 (S2-A): brujula-registration-svc service-account client with manage-users role. G4 RESOLVED: validate via docker compose exec keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kc.sh import --file /opt/keycloak/data/import/realm-export.json. Do NOT commit real secrets.
